titleEn: How Much Does a Basement Suite Renovation Cost in Port Moody, BC? Legalization, Permits & Real Budgets (2026)
titleZh: 满地宝地下室套房装修多少钱？2026年合法化、许可证与真实预算
contentEn:
In Port Moody, BC, a basement suite renovation costs $38,000–$95,000+ in 2026, depending on whether you are converting an existing basement into a legal secondary suite or upgrading a currently non-compliant space to meet City of Port Moody bylaw requirements. Port Moody's relatively compact housing stock — including 1970s–80s ranchers and townhomes in Glenwood, Centre Village, and Heritage Mountain — makes basement suite conversions particularly common among homeowners looking to add rental income or housing for family members.

Reno Stars has completed basement renovation projects across Port Moody, Coquitlam, and the broader Tri-Cities area. This guide covers what Port Moody homeowners actually pay in 2026, the permit requirements specific to Port Moody's building department, and the steps to bring a basement suite into compliance with current BC Building Code standards.

What Does a Basement Suite Renovation Cost in Port Moody in 2026?

Port Moody basement suite renovation costs in 2026 range from $38,000 for a basic conversion with permit compliance to $95,000 or more for a complete legal secondary suite with a new kitchen, full bathroom, and separate entrance. Prices in Port Moody tend to run slightly higher than comparable work in Surrey or Langley due to the higher density of townhome complexes and stricter strata approval requirements where applicable.

Does Port Moody Allow Basement Suites? Understanding the Rules

Yes — the City of Port Moody permits basement suites in single-family residential zones, secondary suites in duplex and townhouse zones, and coach houses in certain areas. The key distinction is whether your property is on a municipal water and sewer system (Port Moody is on Metro Vancouver utilities) and whether your zoning designation allows the specific suite type you are proposing.

Key Port Moody basement suite requirements:

  • Ceiling height of at least 2.1 metres (7 feet) throughout the suite area — this is a hard BC Building Code requirement for all habitable space
  • Separate entrance — either an exterior entrance at grade or an interior entrance from a shared foyer that is separate from the main unit
  • Egress window in every bedroom: minimum 0.35 square metres of openable area, sill no higher than 900mm from the floor
  • Smoke alarms and carbon monoxide detectors: hardwired, interconnected, meeting current BC Electrical Code requirements
  • Independent HVAC zone for the suite, or a properly balanced shared system with independent thermostat control
  • Sound attenuation between the suite and the main floor — minimum STC 33 rating for the separating wall
  • For strata-titled properties: strata council approval is required before applying for a building permit — this can add 30–90 days to the process

Do You Need a Permit for a Basement Renovation in Port Moody?

Yes — any basement renovation in Port Moody that converts a basement to a habitable space or modifies an existing suite requires a building permit from the City of Port Moody Building Division. Key triggers:

  • Adding a kitchen or kitchenette: always requires a building permit and potentially a plumbing permit
  • Adding or relocating a bathroom: always requires a building permit and plumbing permit
  • Creating a separate entrance: always requires a building permit, and may require a sign or exterior alteration permit
  • Egress window installation: always requires a building permit — it involves cutting a structural opening in the foundation wall
  • Finishing an unfinished basement without changing its use: requires a building permit if the work involves structural changes, electrical upgrades, or plumbing
  • Strata approval: for townhome or condo properties, the strata council must approve the renovation before the City will accept a building permit application

Port Moody's building permit processing typically takes 4–6 weeks for standard basement suite applications. Incomplete applications are returned to the applicant which resets the clock, so submitting complete documentation — including architectural drawings, HVAC design, and structural engineering for any egress window or header changes — is critical.

What Drives the Cost of a Port Moody Basement Suite Renovation?

Three factors account for most of the cost variation in Port Moody basement suite projects:

1. Strata approval process (for townhomes and condos). Approximately 40% of Port Moody's housing stock is strata-titled — particularly in neighbourhoods like Glenwood, Seaview, and Contemporary Port Moody. If your property is a townhome or apartment, your strata council must approve the renovation before you can apply for a building permit. This typically adds 30–90 days and sometimes requires a deposit held by the strata corporation. Budget an extra $1,500–$4,000 for strata application fees, engineering reports, and legal review.

2. Egress window requirements. Every bedroom in a basement suite in Port Moody requires an egress window meeting BC Building Code standards. Installing a new egress window in a poured concrete foundation typical of 1970s–80s Port Moody homes costs $3,500–$7,500 depending on the size of the window and accessibility from inside the basement. Heritage Mountain homes with more complex foundation designs may require custom sizing which adds cost.

3. Plumbing scope. If your Port Moody home already has a bathroom rough-in in the basement — common in homes built after 1990 — adding fixtures is relatively affordable. Older homes in areas like Glenwood may need new drain connections which requires core-drilling through the concrete foundation slab, adding $8,000–$18,000 to the project.

Port Moody Basement Suite Renovation: FAQ

Can I add a basement suite to my Port Moody home without a permit?

No — adding a basement suite or legalizing an existing basement suite in Port Moody always requires a building permit from the City of Port Moody. Performing this work without a permit risks a stop-work order, fines, and complications when selling your home as the unpermitted work will appear in title searches.

How long does a Port Moody basement suite renovation take?

A complete basement suite renovation in Port Moody takes 10–18 weeks from building permit approval to final inspection, depending on strata approval timelines, complexity of the work, and contractor availability. The permit application review takes 4–6 weeks. For townhome properties, the strata approval process adds 30–90 days before you can even submit the permit application.

Does Port Moody's bylaw allow short-term rentals in basement suites?

Short-term rentals (under 90 days) are not permitted in most Port Moody residential zones. Port Moody follows Metro Vancouver's short-term rental enforcement framework, and basement suites used for short-term rental purposes without a proper business licence risk enforcement action. Long-term rental use is the permitted path for basement suites in Port Moody.

What is the minimum ceiling height for a basement suite in Port Moody?

BC Building Code requires a minimum ceiling height of 2.1 metres (6 feet 11 inches) for all habitable rooms in a basement. If your basement has lower ceilings, you cannot legally use the space as a suite without excavating and lowering the floor — a significant additional cost of $15,000–$35,000.

在卑诗省满地宝（Port Moody, BC），2026年地下室套房装修费用为38,000至95,000加元以上，具体取决于您是将现有地下室改建为合法第二套间，还是将不合规的空间升级至满足满地宝市政bylaw要求的标准。满地宝相对紧凑的住宅存量——包括格伦伍德（Glenwood）、中心村（Centre Village）和 Heritage Mountain 地区1970至80年代的单层平房和联排别墅——使得地下室套房改建成为希望增加出租收入或为家庭成员提供居所的业主的热门选择。

聚星装修（Reno Stars）已在满地宝、高贵林及三联市（Tri-Cities）地区完成了多个地下室改建项目。本指南涵盖2026年满地宝业主的实际装修费用、满地宝建筑部门的许可证具体要求，以及将地下室套房符合当前BC省建筑规范标准的步骤。

2026年满地宝地下室套房装修要多少钱？

2026年满地宝地下室套房装修费用从带许可证合规的基本改建38,000加元到配备完整厨房和独立入口的合法第二套间95,000加元以上不等。满地宝的价格往往略高于素里或兰里的类似工程，这归因于联排别墅小区密度较高，以及更严格的 strata 审批要求。

工程范围2026年满地宝费用区间包含项目
基本地下室装修（无套房）$28,000 – $45,000保温棉、干墙、地板、基本照明、底层地板、油漆 — 无厨房、无独立卫生间
现有地下室套房合法化$38,000 – $58,000基本项目加逃生窗、耐火门、烟雾/一氧化碳报警器、独立电路面板、防火隔离
带厨房的完整合法第二套间$58,000 – $95,000+合法化项目加新厨房（橱柜、台面、电器）、完整卫生间、独立暖通区域

满地宝是否允许地下室套房？了解相关规定

可以——满地宝市允许单户住宅区的地下室套房、双拼和联排别墅区的第二套间，以及某些地区的后巷屋（coach house）。关键区别在于您的房产是否在市级供排水系统上（满地宝接入大温排水系统），以及您的 zoning designation 是否允许您拟建的具体套房类型。

  • 套房区域净高至少2.1米——这是所有居住空间的BC省建筑规范硬性要求
  • 独立入口——可以是台阶级独立入口或与主屋共享门厅的室内通道
  • 每间卧室的逃生窗：最小开敞面积0.35平方米，窗台高度距地面不超过900毫米
  • 烟雾报警器和一氧化碳探测器：硬线连接、互联，符合当前BC省电气规范要求
  • 套间独立暖通系统或适当平衡的共享系统（带独立温控）
  • 套间与主楼层之间的隔音——隔墙最低STC 33等级
  • strata 产权物业：需获得 strata 议会批准后方可申请建筑许可证——这可能额外增加30至90天

满地宝地下室装修常见问题

我可以不申请许可证就添加地下室套房吗？

不可以——在满地宝添加或合法化地下室套房始终需要从满地宝市申请建筑许可证。无许可证进行此类工程可能导致停工令、罚款，并在您出售房屋时因产权调查中发现无证工程而遇到麻烦。

满地宝地下室套房装修需要多长时间？

满地宝完整的地下室套房装修从建筑许可证批准到最终检查需要10至18周，具体取决于 strata 审批时间、工程复杂程度和承包商可用性。许可证申请审核需要4至6周。对于联排别墅物业，strata 审批流程在您提交许可证申请前额外增加30至90天。

满地宝的bylaw允许地下室套房进行短租吗？

大多数满地宝住宅区不允许90天以下的短租。满地宝遵循大温短租执法框架，将地下室套房用于短租且无适当商业执照可能面临执法行动。长租是满地宝地下室套房的合规路径。

满地宝地下室套房的最低净高要求是多少？

BC省建筑规范要求地下室所有居住房间的最低净高为2.1米。如果您的地下室净高低于此标准，在不挖掘降低地板的情况下，您无法合法地将该空间用作套房——这是一项额外费用$15,000至$35,000的重大工程。
